skills.name: Another Zone

steps.text: Awakens any Elemental Type Zones or a Damage Type Attack Zones or some Hybrid Zones (Double Strike Stance Attack Zones, Moonlight Stance); doubles zone multipliers (+60% Attack/Thunder/Crystal/Shade(other) Zones, +100% Fire/Water/Wind/Earth/Shade Zones); zone cannot be overwritten and duration cannot be extended; removed after duration; via active skills only once per character; no zone / already awakened → awakening not consumed

skills.notes: 규칙 설명 항목(MP 없음) — 실제 각성은 Blastshot 의 awaken step. 각성 2배 · 덮어쓰기 불가 · 만료는 엔진 공통 규칙(§2.4)
